description: Said Derby has his own men.
name: Cuthbert Burbage

description: Gave the order of the night, and the Southampton rumour, without a sum.
name: George Bryan

description: Said a wedding wants paying for, and named the twenty pound still not had.
name: James Burbage

description: Asked who plays, and told you to leave the sentence on the road.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Called it an excellent occasion for paying players who have already been paid.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said a wedding wants a play as a feast wants a fool, and would not write it down.
name: William Shakespeare
